evidence_class: mocked signals and isolated fakeredis; no live Kubernetes, SSH or rollout proof
interfaces: Signal, Source, Reading, Thresholds and Mode
classify returning Classification with State, Terminal, Failure, Confidence, denied sources, suspect_since and needs_operator
projection, carried as the observation field of every agent row in scripts.swarm.status.status_report

supported_versions.runtime_protocol: SV2-RUN-01 to SV2-RUN-03 unchanged; observation classification introduced by SV2-RUN-04
supported_versions.record: Redis hash observations keyed by execution id, fenced by generation and newest evidence time; retained by swarm snapshots

authority: Observer acts only on executions of its own backend that are the current occupant of their seat by execution id and generation; signals naming another execution or generation are discarded and counted. No display label grants authority.

classification.terminal_loss: fresh heartbeat with unreachable terminal: working, terminal degraded
classification.worker_loss: stale heartbeat, or Pod ended, deleted or supervisor exited: suspect; lost only after a prior suspect observation, failure proof and lost_after_s
classification.pod_scheduling: pending Pod without a fresh heartbeat: pending
classification.provider_wait: fresh heartbeat with provider quota_wait: waiting_quota
classification.observation_denied: forbidden or unauthenticated read: never classified as a deleted Pod, never lost
classification.observation_unavailable: unreachable or missing Kubernetes view: suspect, never lost

states.committed: Implementation and fixture inputs committed on tested_commit; generated case manifest identifies exact input hashes.

rollback_rehearsal.action: Set AGENTIHOOKS_OBSERVATION_MODE to conservative: the observer never declares lost and marks every suspect attempt needs_operator for operator classification. The observations hash is retained; the local tick suspect path and RuntimeRouter are unchanged.
rollback_rehearsal.evidence: Case C restores a snapshot into a new store, recovers by relist without a new agent, refuses a stale replay, then a conservative observer holds a deleted Pod as suspect needing the operator past the lost threshold.

remaining_limitations: No Kubernetes, SSH or supervisor signal producer exists at G1; signals are fixture built. Backend adapters in later packages produce them.
The tick still uses its existing remote suspect path; wiring the observer into tick decisions belongs to later runtime packages.
Legacy local agents without an execution record project their heartbeat only, as state unclassified.
next_action: Produce signals from the Kubernetes adapter and route tick suspect and lost decisions through Observer.
